title: autotune: automate batching/caching defaults + quantization profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Sarah Kim
release_notes: Automates selection of batching/caching defaults and quantization profiles; adds unit economics dashboard and CLI autotune command.
description:
Context: Production customers repeatedly ask for predictable per-token cost reductions without sacrificing tail latency. Manual tuning of batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization profiles is error-prone and not portable across models/hardware. This PR implements an opinionated autotune flow that: 1) recommends batching + caching defaults based on live request distribution; 2) selects quantization profiles per-model/per-hardware with performance/quality tradeoffs; and 3) surfaces unit economics in a new UI and CLI command so customers and SREs can evaluate cost/latency regressions.

What this changes (high level):
- runtime/autotune: new autotune engine that ingests request traces and suggests batching/caching defaults.
- runtime/kv_cache: improvements to prefix cache telemetry and an adaptive cache TTL heuristic used by autotune.
- runtime/quant_profiles: adds quantization profile metadata (fp16/int8/int4 candidate sets) and profile evaluation harness.
- tools/uecon: unit-economics service + web dashboard components; exposes per-model cost estimates and delta report for proposed autotune changes.
- cli/redwoodctl: new command `redwoodctl autotune apply` and `redwoodctl autotune preview`.
- docs: updated docs/optimize/autotune.md with examples and safety checklist.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-2145) [x] unit tests [x] integration tests in perf-canary [x] e2e in staging [x] docs updated [x] telemetry enabled

Commits (summary):
- 3c4f1d2: feat(autotune): initial autotune engine and API surface
- 7b9a2fa: perf(kv_cache): adaptive TTL + extra metrics
- e12a4bd: feat(quant_profiles): profile metadata and scoring harness
- a8d9c33: feat(uecon): unit economics service and basic dashboard API
- d45f7ee: cli: add redwoodctl autotune preview/apply subcommands
- fffee11: docs: autotune usage and safety notes + changelog

Files changed (high-level):
- runtime/autotune/* (new): engine, scorer, config templates (rust/python mixed bindings)
- runtime/kv_cache/mod.rs: add ttl heuristics + metrics
- runtime/quant_profiles/*.rs: profile defs + scoring harness
- tools/uecon/service.py, ui/*: backend + dashboard views + API endpoints
- cli/redwoodctl/autotune.go: preview/apply implementations + flags
- docs/optimize/autotune.md: guidance and rollback steps
- perf-canary/configs/autotune-smoke.yaml: canary test harness

Testing and CI:
- Unit test coverage: runtime/autotune (79%), quant_profiles (85%), uecon service (72%).
- Integration: perf-canary run shows median throughput improvement of 18% and median p50 token latency unchanged; p99 latency within SLA for 95% of runs.
- CI: initial lint failed (unused imports in quant_profiles) -> fixed in 7b9a2fa; flaky test in perf-canary (test_batch_schedule) was flaky and pinned (re-ran; passing). Final CI status: pass.

Review highlights (selected):
- Jason Lee: "Great to see the autotune engine split into a light-weight scorer and a heavy evaluator. Two asks: add a safety cap on batch size growth and ensure TTL changes are gradual (we should avoid sudden cache evictions)."
- Sarah Kim (author): "Responded: added safe caps in config (runtime/autotune/config.rs) and TTL ramp schedule; added unit tests for ramp behavior."
- Priya Natarajan: "Please add an explicit quality-regression gating step when applying quant profiles; we shouldn't auto-deploy an int8 profile without a fallback."
- Sarah Kim: "Added mandatory preview step in redwoodctl (autotune preview) which produces a delta report and a `--approve-quality` flag. Also added automatic fallback to baseline profile on regression > 1% exact-match / BLEU-based metric in scoring harness."
- Miguel Alvarez (perf): "Benchmarks look good; two small nits on prometheus metric names and a missing histogram bucket for latency."
- Sarah Kim: "Fixed prometheus labels and added histogram bucket (runtime/metrics.rs)."

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: aggressive batching could increase tail latency for some models. Mitigation: default caps, per-model rollout, and canary in perf-canary.
- Risk: quantization may degrade quality. Mitigation: profile scoring includes quality delta; apply is gated behind `--approve-quality` and automated rollback on deployment failures.

Operational notes:
- Autotune defaults are opt-in at deploy time; cluster admins can enable global autotune via console or redwoodctl.
- Telemetry: new metrics prefixed `autotune_*` and `uecon_*` added; retention added to observability-pack for 90 days in staging.

Merge: Squash-merged after approvals from Jason, Priya, and Miguel. Changelog entry added. Related: Linear ENG-2145, PM-102. If you want to test locally: `./tools/dev_setup.sh && redwoodctl autotune preview --model gpt-4x-small --since 24h` Contact: @sarah (author) for rollout questions.
notes_for_release: Enable autotune via console under Optimize -> Autotune. New CLI commands: redwoodctl autotune preview/apply. Unit economics dashboard under Console -> Cost Optimization.
